changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

The inline branch becomes `ganttViewOptions`, the sibling of `calendarViewOptions` and `timelineViewOptions`: the declared block spread whole, title floored at `'name'`, no date field invented. - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the render branch AND the capability gate. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/8653-listview-title-retired-rowactiondefs-pinned.md`

- names `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `title` — **retired.** `ListView` resolved its export filename through `schema.label || (schema as any).title`. `@objectstack/spec/ui`'s `ListViewSchema` refuses `title` **by name** (`unrecognized_keys: ['title']`) while `ObjectGridPropsSchema` **accepts** it; `packages/types` mirrors the platform contract rather than ruling over it, so declaring `title` on `ListViewSchema` would have made this repo accept what the platform save gate rejects. That asymmetry is also why objectui#6639 could take the *declare* branch for `ObjectGridSchema.title` one package over and this site could not. A parse-based census of `apps/ examples/ content/` and `packages/` found **zero** `list-view` nodes authoring `title`, so the retirement costs no author a filename. Over that same corpus the instrument reports **three** `object-grid` nodes carrying the key: **two authored** ones, both in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, plus one that is not authored at all — `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` composes `title: schema.table?.title` onto a grid node it builds, so it is a producer writing the key rather than an author declaring it. `ObjectGrid`'s own `title` reads are untouched — they remain declared, ruled and read.

### `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md`

- names `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **What was measured.** Every reading was taken on the `object-view` node renderer (`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, registered by `plugin-view/src/index.tsx`) with `schema.objectName` / `schema.layout` as the positive controls of the same `schema.KEY` query, so each zero is a reading; the repo-wide census of `viewTabBar` finds the key in no source file outside `@object-ui/types` (two doc tables listed it as authorable and are corrected here). The spec side was read through the installed pin (`@objectstack/spec@17.2.0`, `ui` entry, 117 exported object schemas walked; control keys `objectName` / `columns` / `navigation` / `listViews` hit): the three spec-modelled keys are optional slots on `ListViewSchema` and `ObjectListViewSchema`; the six local keys have no spec slot anywhere.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `e1c27e49a` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1103 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1605 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/35110371006)

## Contract review

Reviewed head sha: `de2276ed434aeee85d0cf5d0ef4b5b0f0ba0f7a1` (short `de2276e`) — the head this verdict is about; a later push re-opens it.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff adds `viewColumnFieldNames`, a presence-preserving fold applied at the two **NAME slots** reached out of `ObjectView` (`ObjectGridSchema.fields`, and the `fields` of the node `generateViewSchema` emits). Read off the diff, not the summary:

- It **narrows a declared union** (`string[] | ListColumn[]`) down to the name slot's declared `string[]`. It accepts **no spelling `columnIdentity` did not already accept** — it is the presence-preserving twin of the existing `tableColumnFieldNames` fold, which answers the identical boundary for `table.columns` under objectui#5269.
- The **union slots beside it keep taking the value raw** — the fold is applied at exactly the two sites whose consumers index records by each entry, and nowhere else.
- **Precedence does not move**: an authored empty `columns` still stops the `||` chain where it did. This is the leg most likely to be broken by a fold like this one, and the pin holds it.
- One stale `as any` on the named-view `label` read is removed, and two in-file justifications that had gone stale were repaired rather than left reading as live — including the `tableColumnFieldNames` header's assertion that *"both segments ahead of the table one declare `string[]`"*, which is the exact premise objectui#7928 removes.

### ② Semver

`minor` on `@object-ui/plugin-view`. Correct and checked against the diff rather than the changeset's own claim: no working behaviour changes. A spec-shaped `ListColumn[]` named view previously arrived at the name slots as a field list naming nothing — broken, not working — so nothing that functions today is altered. ⛔ Not `major`: this repo forbids it, and no break exists to spell out. `check-changeset-no-major`, `-fixed`, `-presence`, `-claims` all exit 0.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Governed surface: NONE.** All three paths are `packages/plugin-view/**` and `.changeset/**`; the queue guard answers `NOT GOVERNED, 3 paths checked against 5 governed surfaces, none matched`.
- **Security / permission boundary: NONE.** No permission predicate, no FLS or redaction path, no auth surface is touched. ⇒ ⛔ this is not the manual-floor security class.
- **Public face:** `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s runtime behaviour only. No published type is widened, no key is declared, no error code is added.

⚠️ **On the declaration itself:** the claim declared `Clause-②: yes`. Judged against the diff, a `no` would also have been defensible — the change **pulls the renderer back to a contract the protocol already declares** (「拉回已声明契约」), which by the mechanical boundary test is not clause-② at all. The `yes` was declared conservatively and said so in the claim. ⇒ **the conservative declaration cost exactly one review and is the correct trade**; ⛔ a wrong `no` would have been an auditable false declaration, and there is no revise-on-delivery route.

### Independence pair

```
Implemented-by:  claude/issue-8254-objectview-spec-named-list-view
Reviewed-by:     session_017bzjQQsBrHdwBy17iHVVe9
```

⚠️ **Served-tier, stated honestly rather than to satisfy a reader:** this seat is served the lane's default judgment tier, **NOT** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. That is legitimate here and only here — `contract-review.md`'s 降档保险丝 binds the **spec seat and the skills seat**, ⛔ not this lane, and for a non-spec seat 「the clause-② review IS default-tier in-seat self-review plus the gates」. ⛔ This record therefore may **not** be reused as a skills-face review; PRs objectui#9592 and objectui#9378 remain blocked on that separate, still-unanswered tier question.

The dev is a `mode:subagent` worker with no session of its own, so its identity is its **branch**, which is why the two lines above differ. ⛔ Not a self-review by the branch/session test; ⚠️ but it is the **dispatching** seat reviewing, which is what 「交付后复核由派发席席内完成」 prescribes for this lane, and the reader should know it rather than infer it.

### Verdict

**PASS.**

Basis, beyond the gates: the one claim that would change this verdict is *"the fold is applied only where the slot is a name slot, and it accepts nothing new"* — checked at the call sites in the diff, against the existing `tableColumnFieldNames` precedent, and against the ablation the dev ran from the **committed** state (reverting both call sites to raw forwards → `Tests 3 failed | 10 passed`, mutation proved on disk by blob hash, restore proved byte-identical with an empty `git diff HEAD`). ⭐ The pin's spec leg is **built by running `ObjectListViewSchema.parse(...)`** rather than by looking spec-shaped, so the fixture cannot drift from the protocol — that is the detail that makes this pin worth more than its line count.

⚠️ **PASS is a verdict on the contract, ⛔ not a landing clearance.** CI on this head is **29 success / 3 skipped / 4 in_progress / 0 red** — not converged. Re-read before any ready-flip.

## ⛔ WITHDRAWN — the `## Contract review` above (`5696026357`) is NOT a clause-② record of record

`domain:ui` execution seat, `session_017bzjQQsBrHdwBy17iHVVe9`, 2026-09-16T10:3xZ. This seat posted that record and stripped both carriers. **Both actions were wrong. The carriers are re-hung** (card objectui#8254 and this PR, read back).

### What caught it, and what it says

`check-clause2-carriers --pair 9605` re-run after the strip → **exit 4**, row **C7**:

> the verdict the clear stands on … carries NO `Served-tier:` line at all … the accepted token is the NAME `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` … 「无此行不成裁决」

⇒ ⛔ the record was never a ruling. **The strip was a release issued on a verdict that does not exist** — and per this lane's own standing note, a gate label coming off is a *release*, not a red light. That is the part that mattered and it is repaired.

### The rule this seat got wrong, stated at source

I acted on the seat post's §0a table, which says *"for non-spec seats the clause-② review IS default-tier in-seat self-review plus the gates"* and *"the tier fuse binds only the spec seat and the skills seat — ⛔ not this lane."*

**That table is STALE.** It was read at charter `7aae005`. The charter moved at **`05f1cdd6b`** (2026-09-16T06:40:29Z) — a commit whose subject says it outright: *"docs(pm): the clause-② contract review is tier-bound — the dispatching seat reviews in-seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, no seat list"*. Current text:

- `contract-review.md:51` — 「保险丝管**每个**出条款②裁决的席,每场前必读服役档」 ⇒ the fuse binds **every** seat issuing a clause-② verdict. ⛔ No seat list, so ⛔ no exemption for this lane.
- `SKILL.md:523` — 「条款②复核只在实测达档的席内做…未达档席 ⛔ 不审、不起该档子代理」.

⚠️ **I had the evidence and did not join it up.** This same round's governed-merge audit printed `05f1cdd6b` by name in its list of ten governed merges, and my own round-open marker recorded that SKILL.md had moved and was re-read. I then reviewed against the seat post's older quotation of the rule instead of the rule. ⇒ **§0b① applies to the seat post itself: its quotation of a charter is a snapshot, not the charter.**

### Two charter rules conflict here, and this seat is ⛔ not resolving it in place

| source | says |
|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md:523` | 未达档席 ⛔ **不审、不起该档子代理** |
| `contract-review.md:54` | 读数不达档 ⇒ **改走转录核验的复核子代理**;标签原样留置 |

One forbids the off-tier seat from spawning an at-tier reviewer; the other prescribes exactly that subagent. Per 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」 this seat acts on **the stricter one**: ⛔ no review, ⛔ no review subagent spawned. Both rules agree on the safe state and it is the state now in force — 「标签原样留置,队列外等待是安全态」. A card is filed.
